question: Does pointwise reconstruction of pi-1 produce an extension-stable degree-(N,N-1) rational x-map paired with the recovered V-1 map, and does their pointwise composition equal [N] on the complete frozen panel?

degree_model.left_factor: V-1=[t-1]-pi, using the stable parent rational map
degree_model.right_factor: pi-1, reconstructed from pointwise extension-field evaluations
degree_model.scalar_factor: [N] checked by direct scalar multiplication, not reconstructed

dual_kernel_model.simple_roots: one when N is even, from the unique nonzero order-two point in the frozen cyclic groups; zero otherwise
dual_kernel_model.extension_stability: all denominator roots and coefficients are already defined over F_p

composition_model.domain: every point of every frozen extension-field curve, including infinity
composition_model.point_evaluation: use group operations and coordinate Frobenius independently of the reconstructed x-map coefficients

independent_verifier.method: separate Python extension-field/group implementation, Gaussian reconstruction, derivative multiplicity census and complete pointwise composition replay

positive_checks: both first and last canonical 2N windows have full rank and recover identical pi-1 maps
the pi-1 maps have exact degrees (N,N-1), base-field coefficients, and are stable across extensions of each base curve
the recovered denominator roots, simple/double multiplicities and regular counts equal the locked values
the recovered map matches every regular x-value, vanishes at every observed pi-1 pole, and has no numerator cancellation
the parent V-1 and new pi-1 x-maps have equal numerator and denominator degrees
the direct pointwise composition equals [N] on every point in every cell
controls: adding one to the reconstructed numerator constant rejects every regular dual-map sample
adding one to the denominator constant destroys every dual-map pole
using pi instead of pi-1 as the right factor must produce at least one composition failure in every cell
using [N+1] instead of [N] as the scalar result must produce at least one failure in every cell
exactly 2N-1 regular samples fail the strict finite-separation premise
measurements: solver ranks, exact degrees, coefficient encodings and family stability
regular/pole counts, exact root multiplicities, full-sample mismatches and cancellations
complete point count, correct composition failures and both mutation-failure counts
field/group operation counters and elapsed nanoseconds

acceptance.primary: all positive checks pass in all eight cells, both mutation compositions reject in every cell, the three coefficient families are stable, and every exact producer field matches independent replay
acceptance.failure_policy: retain every row and report failures without changing cells, windows, degree model, locked root counts or controls

claim_boundary: This experiment can provide finite pointwise evidence for the norm-factor pair and equal rational x-map degrees on three toy curves. It does not prove that pi-1 is the dual isogeny of V-1, instantiate scheme-theoretic degree, prove generic cyclicity or separability, solve ECDLP, or establish an asymptotic speedup.
